summary: Jazz Pharmaceuticals plc reported the closing of a $1.25 billion private offering of 1.875% exchangeable senior notes due 2032 by its Bermuda subsidiary, Jazz Investments I Limited, including full exercise of the initial purchasers' option for an additional $150 million. Concurrently, the company repurchased approximately $225 million of its ordinary shares at $249.29 per share from note purchasers, funded with cash on hand and under its July 2024 repurchase program. Net proceeds were approximately $1.226 billion for general corporate purposes. The repurchase supports share buyback while raising exchangeable debt; watch for dilution offset and note conversion dynamics.
